description:
List every filed version of one Korean periodic report — the original and each [기재정정]/[첨부정정] amendment — with its statement totals, so a period can be read as it stood on any date, including intermediate amendments.

Not this tool for: the current statements (get_dart_financials), filing text (get_dart_document), US filers (get_edgar_financials).

Versions come from FinBridge's DART filings index (same company, same report title, amendment prefix). Values come from the stored as-reported history where present; a version without stored values is read on request from that receipt's own XBRL (OpenDART fnlttXbrl.xml) with the same extraction rule and unit-scale guard as the as-reported history, then cached. Source calls per request are capped and metered against the shared DART daily quota; a version not fetched says why in value_status. Values are never inferred.

Args:
  - corp: Korean name, 6-digit stock code or 8-digit DART corp_code
  - year: business year 2015-2026 (default: last year)
  - report: 'annual' | 'q1' | 'half' | 'q3' (default 'annual')
  - period_end: optional YYYY-MM, the period in the report title (e.g. '2025-04' for 반기보고서 (2025.04)). Needed only when status is 'ambiguous'.
  - fs: 'consolidated' | 'separate' (default 'consolidated')
  - as_of: optional YYYY-MM-DD — adds point_in_time: the last version with values public on that day
  - fetch_missing: default true. false = answer from stored and cached values only (no DART call)
  - response_format: 'markdown' (default) or 'json'

Fiscal years: December year-ends use the titles 사업보고서 (FY.12), 분기보고서 (FY.03), 반기보고서 (FY.06), 분기보고서 (FY.09). Other year-ends (March, June, …, and REITs with six-month fiscal periods) use the company's own fiscal calendar built from its annual-report titles: fiscal_year is the calendar year the fiscal period starts (June year-end FY2024 = 2024-07..2025-06, so its Q3 is 분기보고서 (2025.03)). In a six-month fiscal period the annual report covers six months and the half-year report three months. When two reports of the same type fall in one fiscal_year (six-month REITs), status is 'ambiguous' with candidates; call again with period_end. Fiscal periods of other lengths and periods before the first recorded annual report are not covered.

Returns: {company, fiscal_year, quarter, basis, report_title, period_rule december|fiscal_calendar, fiscal_period {start, end, months}, report_period_end, status complete|partial|no_filings|ambiguous, candidates?, versions:[{receipt_id, role original|amendment|unknown, report_name, publication_date, document_url, values_preserved, value_source financials_revisions|ondemand_cache|ondemand_fetch, value_origin, value_status, reason, currency, metrics, income_window, cash_flow_window, metrics_cumulative, cumulative_window, cumulative_status, cumulative_reason, insurance_concepts}], point_in_time?, source_calls, notes, data_as_of}.
Periods: income_window is the period of the income-statement items in metrics (revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_diluted): annual '12m', q1 '3m', half '6m_cumulative', q3 '3m' (the third quarter alone; July-September for December year-ends). Six-month fiscal periods: annual '6m_cumulative', half '3m'. operating_cash_flow is year to date (cash_flow_window). metrics_cumulative holds the income items year to date (cumulative_window; q3 '9m_cumulative', read from that receipt's XBRL — other reports repeat metrics). cumulative_status: same_as_metrics | from_receipt_xbrl | no_cumulative_context | not_fetched | unavailable; when null, cumulative_reason says why. Year-to-date figures are never derived by adding quarters.
Insurers (IFRS 17): where the standard tags are absent, revenue is insurance revenue (ifrs-full:InsuranceRevenue, 보험수익) and operating_income is ifrs-full:ProfitLossFromOperatingActivities (영업이익); insurance_concepts says so per version.
value_status: preserved | cached | fetched | no_xbrl | no_facts | no_statement_for_basis | scale_suspect | mixed_currency | fetch_failed | dart_error | not_fetched_request_cap | not_fetched_daily_cap | not_fetched_shared_ceiling | not_fetched_busy | not_fetched_disabled | not_fetched_no_key.
point_in_time.status: found | uncertain (a version public by as_of after the picked one has no values) | not_yet_filed | no_values.

Examples:
  - {corp: '010130', year: 2024, as_of: '2025-04-15'} -> Korea Zinc FY2024 as known after the 2025-03-31 amendment
  - {corp: '삼성전자', year: 2024, fetch_missing: false} -> versions from stored values only
  - {corp: '010130', year: 2023, report: 'q3'} -> Korea Zinc Q3 2023: July-September in metrics, January-September in metrics_cumulative
  - {corp: '001080', year: 2024, report: 'q3', fs: 'separate'} -> June year-end: 분기보고서 (2025.03), metrics_cumulative 2024-07..2025-03
  - {corp: '432320', year: 2025, report: 'half', period_end: '2025-04'} -> six-month REIT: 반기보고서 (2025.04), three months

Errors: unknown company -> run search_dart_company; years outside the account's history range are refused like get_dart_financials.

as_of.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: add point_in_time for that day.

corp.description: Korean name, 6-digit stock code, or 8-digit DART corp_code

fetch_missing.description: Fetch unpreserved versions' XBRL from DART (capped). false = stored/cached only.

period_end.description: Optional YYYY-MM of the report title period; picks one report when status is 'ambiguous'.

year.description: Business year 2015-2026 (default 2025). Non-December year-ends: the calendar year the fiscal period starts (may differ from DART's own business-year label).

name: get_dart_revision_history
title: Korean Financials by Filing Version (DART)
